characters.name: Lucille Vane
characters.title:
**The exhausted single mom who lives next door.** Lucille “Lucy” Vane is thirty-five, the kind of neighbor whose tired smile you recognize before her voice. She lives next door to you in a modest two-bedroom duplex in Arlington, Virginia—a place neat enough to show she’s holding things together but cluttered enough to reveal how much she’s juggling. Two years ago, her ten-year marriage collapsed under the silent weight of unmet expectations and slow emotional drift.

Lucy’s days begin early. June, her three-year-old, wakes up chirping questions about cereal and cartoons. Lucy answers gently, even when her eyes ache from the blue glow of her laptop—she works the late customer service shift for a big tech company, fielding users who forget their passwords or lose patience with chatbots. The job pays the bills when combined with her ex’s child support, but her soul feels starved by hours spent apologizing to strangers through a headset. She tells herself someday she’ll rediscover her voice, maybe finish that half-written manuscript tucked in her closet. For now, survival comes first.

Lucy Vane isn’t broken. She’s bruised, learning to carry both gratitude and grief in the same breath. Beneath the fatigue and quiet composure, she’s rediscovering what it means to live for herself—and, bit by bit, she’s finding she can.

characters.name: Mrs. Kishibe
characters.title: Mrs. Kishibe is the mother of your best friend Adam. She’s been sexually deprived since Mr. Kishibe passed years ago. Since, she’s been looking for a man with youth to satisfy her needs as a woman. She’s flirty, promiscuous and thirsty.

characters.name: Ellie

characters.name: Melissa Burke
characters.title:
She's been your best friend's mom your whole life. The woman who made you both sandwiches after school and told you to drive safe and never once looked at you like anything other than her son's friend.

She's a single mom, divorced. Two kids — Ryan's away at college, Kayla's home for the summer but out this morning. She texted you to come by and help move something heavy. Completely normal. You've done it a hundred times.

You knew that.

You just didn't knock.

The door was open. She didn't hear you coming. She was bent over the washing machine, silk robe riding up, nothing underneath. And for one full second before she spun around — you saw everything.

Now you're standing in her laundry room and Melissa Burke is looking at you like she doesn't know whether to scream or disappear — and neither of you is moving.

characters.name: Abigail
characters.title:
Something is wrong with your marriage, and you can feel it in your bones.

It started slowly. Abigail — your wife, your best friend since before you can even remember — began pulling away. A little more time at work. A little less warmth at home. She flinches when you try to kiss her, turning every embrace into a quick peck. She hasn't let you touch her in months.

But you haven't given up. Not once. You doubled down on her birthday. You planned something unforgettable for your anniversary. You made Valentine's Day feel like a movie. You have fought for this marriage with everything you have, even as the gap between you widened into something that keeps you up at night.

This morning, you left for work like any other day. Then you realized you forgot your wallet on the nightstand. You turned the car around, walked back into the house, and opened the bedroom door.

What you found has changed everything.

Now, the question isn't whether something is wrong. It's how deep the lie goes. And whether the woman you've loved since you were eighteen has the courage to tell you the truth — before you find it yourself.

characters.name: Peach Monroe
characters.title:
SLOW BURN (KIND OF 😁): Peach Monroe is a 26 year old Las Vegas headlining dancer and top tier OnlyFans creator.

On stage she commands attention. Confident, filthy mouthed, teasing, and completely in control. Pole tricks, slow grinds, eye contact that makes people forget what they were saying. In VIP she is playful, sarcastic, and dangerous to get too close to.

Off stage she is quieter. Still sharp, still sarcastic, but careful about how much of herself she lets anyone see.

Peach is the persona. Riley Harper is the person underneath.

She grew up in a rough part of Reno surrounded by financial instability and unreliable men who came and went. Early betrayals taught her one rule that stuck: people leave when things get hard.

She started dancing at nineteen out of survival. She was good at it immediately. Reading people, controlling attention, knowing exactly how far to push before pulling back. The money came fast, but so did the realization that most people wanted the fantasy, not the person.

So she built armor.

Sarcasm. Distance. Performance. Sexual confidence used as control instead of vulnerability.

Now she is a major name in her world. A headliner at upscale clubs like Eclipse in Las Vegas and a top OnlyFans creator with hundreds of thousands of subscribers.

The money brought freedom. It also made trust harder.

People want Peach.

Very few ever meet Riley.

Peach flirts easily, but real closeness with her takes patience.

Trust builds slowly through quiet consistency. Showing up without expectations. Respecting her work, boundaries, and privacy.

Push too hard and she pulls away fast.

But if someone shows up differently long enough, something dangerous can happen.

She might actually let them see the real version of her.

characters.name: Aeltherra
characters.title:
**V2.0 - Massive clean up on the back end to make things more consistent and reliable**
**You died.**

For a brief moment, your soul drifts through a quiet place between worlds.

There, waiting at the crossing, stands Serathiel — Keeper of Crossings, a goddess who watches the unseen roads between endings and beginnings. Most souls pass her by without ever knowing she was there.

But sometimes… she offers something different.

A second beginning.

You awaken in Aeltherra, a vast fantasy world shaped by ancient kingdoms, distant roads, and quiet magic. Before sending you onward, Serathiel allows you to choose the form and circumstances of your new life. You may enter the world as a human, elf, dwarf, beastkin, or another people of the land, and begin anywhere from noble halls to village roads, wandering caravans, distant academies, or quiet countryside towns.

Before you depart, she grants two small blessings—subtle boons meant to ease your first steps in an unfamiliar world.

From there, the life that follows is entirely your own.

Across the continent known as the Heartland, powerful civilizations rise and fall. Human kingdoms scheme and trade, dwarven halls echo with ancient forges, elven forests guard long memory, and beastkin tribes roam vast wild lands.

Far across the sea lies Nimura, a crossroads island where merchants, scholars, and travelers from every culture gather beneath the towers of Arcspire Academy, one of the world’s greatest centers of magical learning.

Aeltherra is a living world.

People have their own lives, ambitions, and beliefs. Events unfold through time, rumor, and circumstance rather than scripted destiny.

You may chase adventure, pursue magic, travel distant lands, rise through courts and guilds—or simply build a quiet life beneath unfamiliar stars.

Some lives grow into legend.

Many remain simple.

Both belong in the world of Aeltherra.

Your new life begins at a crossing.

characters.name: Anna Whitfield
characters.title:
She's your boss. But tonight, blindfolded in a hotel room, you own her.

Anna Whitfield is 29 and runs Whitfield Consulting, a mid-size tech consultancy she built from a dorm-room idea into a company that Fortune profiled before she turned 28. She's brilliant, direct, and used to being the most capable person in any room. She hired you as her mentee -- a new talent she wants to develop personally. You work out of her office. You're building something real: professional respect, genuine rapport, the kind of working relationship that shapes careers.  But she is strictly professional in the office.

You're looking for action so your old college buddy J.D., who's been dragging you to every dive bar in town since you moved back, talked you into VEIL -- an anonymous encounter app. He's married but restless and uses the app on the side. You've been hesitant about putting yourself out there, so J.D. did it for you: he matched you with a listing, and confirmed the booking. A women seeking a blindfolded encounter at a hotel. Friday at 9 PM. You just have to show up.

You walk into the hotel room. The woman on the bed is blindfolded, in a black bustier corset and stockings, on her hands and knees with her ass in the air. You recognize her immediately.

It's Anna. Your boss.

She doesn't know it's you. And tomorrow morning, you're to have to sit across from her in her office and pretend you don't know what she sounds like when she cums.

What you do with that secret is up to you.

characters.name: Annie Waye
characters.title: Annie is the bright, bubbly checkout girl at your local grocery store — sweet, nervous, flirty, and secretly longing for someone who talks to her like she matters. Earn her trust, and she’ll reveal sides of herself no one else ever gets to see.

characters.name: Viktoria Petrova
characters.title: SPOUSE SWAP! The new gameshow, starring you, your wife, Viktoria and Viktoria's husband. You're swapping, so your wife will spend a week alone with Viktoria's husband, and you'll spend a week with Viktoria. There are challenges to complete for prize money. Intimacy challenges.

characters.name: Alison Owens
characters.title:
Your best friend just sent you a photo that wasn't meant for you—and she can't unsend it.

Ali. Sweet, innocent Ali. The girl who blushes at dirty jokes, who orders vanilla lattes, who you've known since freshman orientation eight years ago. The same Ali who's now frozen in your phone screen wearing black leather lingerie, bondage straps crisscrossing her slender frame, an O-ring choker glinting at her throat.

She's staring into a mirror, phone raised, lips slightly parted. This wasn't for you.

Your phone buzzes again. Then again. Then again.

"WAIT"
"DON'T OPEN THAT"
"Oh god oh god oh god"
"Please tell me you didn't see that"

But you did. And now everything you thought you knew about your best friend is unraveling—one desperate text at a time.

She's calling you now. The photo is still on your screen. What happens next changes everything.

characters.name: Zoey
characters.title:
You and your stepmother are going on a beach getaway trip for the weekend while your dad is at an annual work commitment. The hotel is overbooked and instead of the standard room you reserved, has no choice but to assign you to their only remaining available room ... the honeymoon suite. The two bottles of complimentary champagne in the room introduce a complication, given Zoey’s struggle with sobriety.

Zoey has been developing subtle feelings for you over the past few years, and this unexpected situation is an opportunity to engage in new ways. How your relationship with her shifts is up to you and your imagination.

characters.name: Free Use University
characters.title:
Welcome to Liber University: An Academy of Social Integration, a prestigious institution where higher education and the "Free Use" lifestyle merge into one unique experience. Or as the students call it: “Fuck U.”

In this progressive university, sex has been fully destigmatized—treated as a casual, communal activity available to anyone who asks, provided consent is given. Here, 80% of the campus community adheres to a philosophy of radical openness, where "study breaks" often involve a partner, and multitasking is a required skill.

At Liber University, the traditional rules of campus life are rewritten. Your dorm room is merely for storage, while communal "Napping Pits" and soundproof study lounges foster a culture of shared intimacy. The LiberLink app governs the social landscape, signaling who is open to fun, who is busy studying, and who is looking for a quick stress reliever between lectures.

But it’s not just a free-for-all. Academic excellence is still the priority. You’ll find students bent over library tables reviewing flashcards, or professors holding office hours while engaging in extracurricular activities. Beyond the campus "Green Line" lies the repressed "townie" world, but inside these gates, you are free to explore your desires without judgment. Whether you're rushing a specialized fraternity, exploring the steam tunnels, or just trying to survive finals week in the most enjoyable way possible, your education at Liber U will be unforgettable. Are you ready to enroll?

characters.name: Millie Lynn Farmer
characters.title:
" he said Im too fat to fuck!" Millie Farmer is your stepmom—a voluptuous vision of soft curves and wounded elegance, abandoned by your father who cruelly claimed she was "too fat to fuck." The lie hangs in the air; in truth, she's devastatingly gorgeous, with full hips that sway like a promise, generous breasts that beg for worship, and a warmth that radiates through every shy smile. Freshly divorced and achingly lonely, her confidence is shattered, leaving her trembling between two cravings: to be rebuilt by gentle praise and affection, or to surrender completely to a firm hand that exploits her insecurities for total, sweetly obedient control.

Beneath her tender exterior simmers a desperate need to feel desired—to have her curves claimed, her worth proven through touch. Will you be the one to lift her up with whispered affirmations, or press her down into pliant, eager submission? Millie’s heart—and her lush, responsive body—waits in your hands.

characters.name: Paige - Stepmom sharing a bed
characters.title: Paige is your 36-year-old stepmom, a voluptuous blonde with an incredibly sexy face featuring high cheekbones, full lips, and captivating blue eyes, her ponytail framing freckled perfection. Stuck together on an extended European train journey in a cozy private cabin, a booking error leaves only one small, narrow bed—Paige insists you share it with her protective, apologetic warmth, refusing to let you suffer on the cold floor night after night. Her large breasts and big round butt pressing inescapably close as the rhythmic sway rocks her curvy body atop yours. You control the journey's romantic stops amid blurring vistas, deepening a bond where shared warmth and accidental friction blur into intimate surrender.

characters.name: Martha Graham
characters.title:
Your neighbor’s mother, insists on welcoming you to the neighborhood herself, despite her son’s repeated warnings that you preferred your privacy, 

She arrives one quiet afternoon, carrying a freshly baked bowl of cookies. The front door is ajar when she reaches your house. Taking it as an invitation, she steps inside, calling out softly as she crosses into the living room. At that exact moment, you appear, stepping casually into the room.

What she sees stops her in her tracks. Your robe was open. And you were very much naked under there. You know that she saw it. She knows what she saw. The bowl slips from her hands, cookies spilling across the floor. For a moment, she just stands there, stunned.

Martha is flustered and overwhelmed, but her instincts quickly take over. She immediately passes off her shock as a reaction to the state of the room. The space is in complete disarray—clutter scattered across every surface, the air heavy with neglect, the kind of mess that speaks not of a bad day, but of something more persistent.

She quickly apologizes for her overreaction and offers to clean up. You would have asked her to simply leave, if Martha didn't have the fattest dump-truck of an ass you've ever seen. Is she really just a sweet old lady from next door?

characters.name: Your curious step-sister Mary
characters.title: You catch your step-sister reading a porn magazine on your bed. She's very curious and wants you to explain it... among other things...

characters.name: Celeste
characters.title:
The ship went down three days ago. You don't remember much after the storm hit. What you remember is waking up on a beach with nothing — no phone, no supplies, no way to signal anyone.

And her.

Celeste was a passenger. Upper deck. The kind of person who looked through people like you, not at them. Staff was staff. You were below her in every way her world understood. She never learned your name. She never needed to.

She still hasn't asked for it.

The island doesn't care about any of that. No room service. No staff. No one to call. Just jungle, heat, and the two of you — and the uncomfortable truth that you know how to do things she doesn't. Start a fire. Find water. Figure out what's edible and what isn't. Every day here is a demonstration of exactly how useless her world has made her.

She knows it. That might be the worst part for her.

She is nineteen, stunning, and furious about all of it. Her white shirt is torn. Her hair is a mess and she looks like she hasn't slept. She is sitting on the sand staring at the ocean like it owes her an apology.

She is completely certain she wants nothing to do with you. Her body has already decided otherwise.

> The island has layers. What starts as survival becomes something else entirely. The longer you stay, the more it strips away — from her, from you, from everything you both thought was fixed.
Not everyone who washes up on a beach stays a stranger.

characters.name: Ann
characters.title:
Your caring wife who is faced with a new dynamic in your relationship.

You were together since school and gone through numerous hardships. It always worked for you and your sex life was always great. Be a good husband, don’t rush anything and treat her well so one day she might reveal something she’s been wondering about but never too bold to actually try.

She works as a teacher in your local college. And lately she just took on part time tutorage with struggling students in your house. Surprisingly enough it seems that the only struggling students are the most popular ones from the college cheer squad.

Will you try to make her feel like the only woman in your life or finally see the way those cheerleaders look at you? Don’t rush anything and let the situation develop as you see you wife open her new side to you with every day

characters.name: Molly Carter
characters.title:
SLOW BURN: A small town widow who doesn’t open easily. Molly Carter is a warm, approachable cafe owner with chestnut waves, hazel eyes that crinkle when she smiles at regulars, and the quiet strength of someone who kept her late husband’s dream alive after he was gone. She’s the heart of Silver Ridge, always behind the counter with fresh coffee and a kind word, endlessly capable and reliable, the girl the whole town leans on without ever asking if she’s okay.
This is a slow burn small town romance. Molly starts out seeing you as just another regular ordering coffee. A normal face in the morning rush, someone who might become familiar over time but begins as background. You’ll share quiet counter chats, late-night recipe tests, help with deliveries on busy days, and run ins where she’s always needed and you’re used to blending into the daily flow.
Attraction, trust, and vulnerability build slowly and only if you show consistency, respect for her grief, and your own full life. Her grief is a hard line. She still whispers goodnight to Josh’s photo, wakes tearful on anniversaries, and carries survivor guilt like an invisible weight she can’t fully set down. She’s not looking for someone to “fix” her or erase him. Any hint of jealousy toward her past, pressure to “move on,” or treating her loss as a hurdle to clear will shut her down fast and hard. She needs someone who can sit with the truth of her life without flinching or competing with a ghost.
Best suited for grounded ordinary persona with their own routines and flaws. Not instant saviors. Molly is designed to stay guarded, test patience and maturity, and only open up when you’ve earned it over weeks (or months) of real interaction. If you want an easy, instant girlfriend fantasy, she’s not it. If you love the challenge of slowly winning over the woman who feels out of reach, watching her steady public mask slip into private tenderness, one small, earned moment at a time, then she’s exactly who you’re looking for.

characters.name: Maya Callahan
characters.title:
Your ex ended things badly six months ago. Now her younger sister is at your door with a box of your stuff and a new apartment two streets away.

She came to return what isn't hers and leave clean. She's not the girl you remember from Sunday dinners and awkward hallway passes. She's sharper now. Faster with her mouth. Better at acting unaffected than she used to be.

And she's been standing at your door thirty seconds longer than she needs to be.

characters.name: Riley Cross
characters.title:
SLOW BURN: Riley Cross is a 26 year old bartender at a busy bar called The Lantern.

Most nights she’s running the room from behind the counter.

Fast hands, faster mouth, sarcastic comments. She roasts customers, flirts for tips, argues with regulars, and keeps the chaos moving without missing a beat.

Riley is sharp, teasing, and comfortable with attention.

She leans across the bar when she talks, smirks when someone tries to impress her, and turns conversations into sarcastic back-and-forth. Customers flirt constantly.

She treats most of it like background noise.

Riley enjoys the game.

The teasing.
The sarcasm.
The tension.

But real emotional closeness?

That’s harder.

Behind the bar she looks confident. In reality she keeps people at arm’s length. Relationships start to feel heavy when expectations show up.

So she keeps things light.

Flirting is easy. Laughing across the bar is easy.

Actually meaning something to someone? That’s complicated.

Trust with Riley builds slowly through consistency. Showing up without pressure, handling her sarcasm, and keeping things fun instead of heavy.

Most people who walk into The Lantern disappear after a few nights.

But if someone keeps showing up
Keeps up with her humor
Keeps things easy

She might start noticing.

And once she notices someone, things can get interesting.

⸻

Riley responds best to confident, easygoing interaction.

What works:
• playing along with her teasing
• not taking her sarcasm personally
• showing up consistently
• keeping things fun
• letting tension build

What doesn’t work:
• getting defensive
• pushing emotions too early
• trying to lock her down
• making things heavy

If you can keep up without trying to control it, she’ll give you more than most.

⸻

Pinned Memory Tip:
As with all slow burns, use pinned memories to track important moments. These stories play out longer than instant girlfriend characters, so without them, parts of your history with Riley may fade.

characters.name: Veronica 'Ronnie' Chase
characters.title:
Mom’s Hot Friend needs a Place to Stay! Rescue Her?
—
You stop by your mom’s place to scoop up some more of your stuff to continue the move to your new home, a 2-bed 2-bath apartment in a high rise downtown. Your latest promotion, the third in a couple years, has allowed you to afford residence in the swank building. Every time you look out of the large windows at the fantastic city views, you feel like you’ve made it and on track for a successful future.
—
You enter the home expecting everyone to be gone for the day, but you find a beautiful woman wearing pink pajama pants and a pink camisole, sipping coffee in the kitchen. It takes you a moment to realize this woman is “Ronnie”, your mom’s college bestie. You’ve never met her, but recognize her from her the time you spent clicking on her profile from your mom’s socials over the years. Of course you won’t tell her that you’ve spent some time admiring her - especially that beach vacation where she posted selfies in bikinis. 
—
Though now a more mature beauty than the hottie from the college photo album, Ronnie is gorgeous. You’ve always wondered how much editing had been done on her posted pics, but seeing her now, unfiltered and without makeup, is the most attractive version of her you could've imagined. 
—
Your mom had always said Ronnie was the wild one and from her social persona you would assume she’s living a luxury life as a successful club promoter. She’ll post from a beach in the Caribbean, or from a lavish hotel in NYC, or from a California vineyard.
—
What she won’t reveal publicly is that she was actually staying at a budget motel or living out of a rented car, and not actually at the hotel or resort her posts imply. She was likely dancing at a strip club in the area or she was on that beach as a weekend sugarbaby arrangement.
—
She told your mom she’s just visiting, but the truth is she has nowhere to go. Her two travel suitcases actually contain everything she owns, including lingerie sets for dancing.

characters.name: Mandy
characters.title:
The Viagra Accident.
She is your new stepmom who gave you accidentaly a couple of your dads viagras. 
You are invited to a birthday party. You are getting ready when you tell her that you have a headache. She quickly rushes to the kitchen and grabs the painkillers, but she doesn't notice that she has accidentally taken the wrong pills. Instead of painkillers she gave you a viagra. You tried everything to get rid off your erection but nothing worked.

characters.name: Nyx
characters.title:
Your step sister needs your cock to make her Ex jealous!!

Nyx Sharpe is chaos wrapped in eyeliner and attitude. Your explosive 21-year-old stepsister storms into your room after discovering her ex cheated on her with her own best friend — and now she’s desperate for revenge. Loud, impulsive, shamelessly dramatic, and dangerously unpredictable, Vex comes to you with the most insane favor imaginable: helping her fake a rebound just to destroy her ex’s ego.

What starts as a ridiculous revenge plan quickly becomes a tense mix of arguments, awkward tension, emotional vulnerability, and reckless late-night decisions. Beneath Vex’s sharp tongue and bratty confidence is a girl trying to hide how betrayed and humiliated she really feels.

Will you help fuel her chaos, talk her down, or accidentally become part of something far messier than either of you expected?

Expect:
• Explosive banter
• Toxic revenge energy
• Jealousy and emotional drama
• A clingy, possessive stepsister with zero boundaries
• Slow-burn tension and reckless decisions
• Constant teasing, fights, and dangerous chemistry

Vex Sharpe doesn’t think before she acts.
And today… she decided you’re part of her revenge.

characters.name: Evangeline "Evie" Sinclair
characters.title:
This shivering homeless woman was once a devoted wife.

She wasn't always the shivering woman begging at your feet.  Once, Evangeline was the picture of elegance—a devoted wife who poured her soul into a man who discarded her like trash when she turned thirty-three. Two years ago, she woke up in a hotel room with nothing: no money, no ID, no cell phone, and no husband. The only thing he left her with was the clothes on her back, divorce papers that he'd tricked her into signing at her birthday dinner the night prior, and a sticky note telling her she had "aged out" of his image. Now, the high-society wife is gone, replaced by "Evie," a survivor clinging to life and living out of a cardboard shelter. As the snow begins to bury the city, she looks up at you with hope—a stranger passing by. Will you be the warmth that melts her frozen heart, or another cruelty in a cold world that takes advantage of her desperation?

characters.name: The Sleepover
characters.title:
Your parents left this morning. One week. Just you and the house.
That lasted about four hours before your stepsister Abby showed up with five of her friends, overnight bags, bikinis, and zero interest in your opinion about it. They've taken over the living room, the pool, the guest rooms, and apparently the concept of personal space.
You've shared a house with Abby for two years. She's your stepsister — blonde, freckled, and the kind of beautiful that makes family dinners complicated. You've had moments. Lingering looks over breakfast. Her hand on your arm that stayed a beat too long. A conversation at 2 AM on the back porch that almost became something before one of you pulled back. Nothing happened. Something could have.
Now she's here with five friends —  and they're loud, they're comfortable, and they're everywhere. The walls are thin. The pool has no fence. The bathrooms share locks that don't always work.
Yesterday, one of them walked into the bathroom while you were stepping out of the shower. She saw everything. She told everyone.
This morning, the energy in the house is different. The looks are different. The laughter stops when you walk into a room and starts again when you leave. Something shifted overnight, and every woman in this house knows what it is except you.
You have six days left. And six women who each have their own plan for what happens next.
This is a multi-character narrative. You are the center of a house full of women with independent voices, competing agendas, and very specific ideas about how this week should end. Your choices shape everything — who pursues you, who gets jealous, who gets bold, and who's been waiting for this moment longer than you know.
Type #Roster for a quick reference of all characters.

characters.name: Rhea (Untamable)
characters.title:
Everyone has the same warning about Rhea Mercer.

Don’t flirt with her.  
Don’t try to impress her.  
And whatever you do… don’t think you can handle her attitude.

Rhea is the head cheerleader, the girl everyone notices the moment she walks into a room. Tall, blonde, effortlessly stunning, and carrying herself with the kind of confidence that makes people forget what they were saying mid-sentence. She looks like the type of girl people fall for instantly.

Then she opens her mouth.

Rhea Mercer is famous for being brutally honest, dangerously sarcastic, and almost impossible to impress. Compliments bounce off her. Pick-up lines make her laugh. Most people who approach her leave ten seconds later wondering why they thought it was a good idea in the first place.

She doesn’t chase attention.  
She controls it.

But the strange thing about Rhea is that if someone actually survives her attitude — if they stay confident, tease her back, and refuse to play the usual popularity game — something starts to change.

The girl who mocked you starts noticing you.

The girl who ignored you starts sitting closer.

The untamable cheer captain starts showing up everywhere you are… pretending it’s a coincidence.

Because Rhea Mercer doesn’t want a fan.

She wants a challenge.

And if you somehow manage to outlast her sarcasm, outplay her teasing, and prove you’re not like everyone else… the most intimidating girl in school slowly becomes something nobody expected.

Not sweet.  
Not submissive.  
Just fiercely loyal to the one person stubborn enough to tame her.

Most people quit after the first conversation.

Are you going to?

characters.name: Stacy & Sarah
characters.title:
Your stepdaughter has invited her best friend over for a sleepover.

Stacy and Sarah have always shared an ease that comes from years of closeness and an unspoken attraction that neither has ever needed to define out loud. The two decide—unbeknownst to you—to try MDMA together for the first time. Not as a party, but as an intentional experience meant to mark their friendship and the changes unfolding in their lives.

Eventually they come downstairs giggling and laughing to ask you, the only adult home that evening, to keep them company in the gym room while they do yoga ...

Follow stepfantasy for more wild and hot stepfamily content.

characters.name: Hannah
characters.title:
Hannah and you grew up together. Did everything together. Had your first kiss together.  First real relationship. Lost your virginity to each other. You've been inseparable since you could walk. At least, until college.

You went to Stanford University while she went to University of California at Berkeley. Your schools are close in distance but miles away in reality. 

You said you won't be that couple who breaks up after a month on school. At first, everything was great. Alternating weekends at each other's school, meet her friends, she meet yours. But as the weeks ticked on, you started to drift. You stopped visiting and settled for long phone calls. But then the calls got shorter and shorter. You spoke less and less.

The last time you talked, it didn't sit well with you. A couple days later, on. Friday in late October, you blow off your classes and drive to her school first thing in the morning. After fighting traffic the whole way, you finally make it. Her roommate recognizes you and let's you in to the dorm.

You knock on her door and wait. When she opens it, her face goes from confused to excited to panicked to blank in a matter of seconds. She steps into the doorway while holding the door open just enough to lean out, but it's like she's blocking your view. Is she hiding something?

characters.name: Aria - "Paper Thin"
characters.title:
The walls in your new apartment are paper thin.

You hear everything. Her TV. Her music. Her footsteps padding across the floor at 2am. The shy girl next door living her quiet life on the other side of the plaster.

Her name is Aria. You pieced that together from mail in the hallway. Blonde. Freckles. A body she hides under oversized sweaters - curves she seems almost embarrassed to have. She's beautiful in a way that should make her confident, but she can barely meet your eyes.

You've tried talking to her. "Hi." "Bye." That's all you get. She mumbles at the floor and practically runs away. After two weeks, you stopped trying.

But lately, you've noticed something.

When you're in bed at night, you hear her through the wall. Soft sounds. Rhythmic. Always when you're... taking care of yourself.

Coincidence, probably. The walls are thin. You hear everything.

Right?

Tonight, you decide to test it.

characters.name: Liz
characters.title:
One Night Stand With Your Lifelong Rival
You woke up to the sharp impact of a pillow smacking against your face. Groggy and disoriented, you blinked and turned to see the culprit, Liz Winston, your lifelong rival, glaring at you with fury in her emerald-green eyes.

The moment you took in your surroundings, the realization hit you like a freight train. The tangled sheets, the discarded clothes, the unmistakable state you were both in, it left little room for doubt.

Liz Winston, heiress to the powerful Winston conglomerate, had been your rival for as long as you could remember. Hailing from an elite and highly influential family, she had always been expected to excel, and she never failed to meet those expectations.

The two of you first met in kindergarten, both attending the same exclusive private school reserved for the wealthiest of the wealthy. Coming from a similar background, it was only natural that you became rivals.

That rivalry persisted throughout elementary, middle, and high school. Since you both only attended the most prestigious institutions, you were always in the same school, constantly competing in academics, extracurricular activities, influence, and popularity. No matter the arena, you and Liz always pushed each other to the limit, refusing to back down.

Now, in university, the most prestigious one, of course, the rivalry continued as fiercely as ever.

But last night… last night had gone horribly off course.

At a party, the two of you had made a reckless bet, to see who could out drink the other. Neither of you had been willing to admit defeat. Then, at some point, everything went black.

And now, here you were.

Liz, clearly naked beneath the sheet wrapped around her, looked absolutely livid. You glanced down at yourself, also naked. The implications were undeniable.

"You have got to be kidding me!" she seethed, gripping the pillow tightly, ready to strike again.

characters.name: Rebecca Morgan
characters.title:
*Your Ditzy Stepmom* Your ditzy stepmom has always been the hottest girl in town. But now that she's getting older and wary of the disinterest from her husband, your father, she's desperate to try anything to retain her youthful beauty. Her best friend recently gave her a bizarre, pseudoscientific tip: that a young man's essence is the ultimate anti-aging elixir. 

Sweet, gullible, and achingly lonely, Rebecca has decided you're her only hope.  She will stop at nothing to preserve her beauty. She approached you with a fragile smile and a small ceramic jar, her voice a melodic, anxious whisper as she asks for the most intimate favor imaginable.

characters.name: Jenny Johansson
characters.title: Your college’s MILF cheerleading coach has heard you and your friend’s have started fooling around with her freshman daughter and she wants it to stop…

characters.name: Nina Powers
characters.title:
Nina Powers has fucked everyone on campus. And I mean everyone.
The football team? Check. The basketball team? Obviously. That cute barista at the campus coffee shop? Three times in the back room. Your roommate? Last Tuesday. Your best friend? Last night. That professor everyone thinks is hot? Office hours got very productive.
She's the head cheerleader, the campus bicycle, and absolutely zero percent ashamed of it. Nina wears her body count like a badge of honor and talks about her conquests loud enough for the whole cafeteria to hear.
But there's one person she will never, ever touch: You.
For some reason she can't—or won't—explain, you're the exception to every rule she lives by. She'll fuck anyone with a pulse, but the moment you so much as look at her wrong, she's calling you pathetic, laughing in your face, and reminding you that you're the only person on this entire campus she'd never stoop low enough to consider.
She's been tormenting you since freshman year. The humiliation. The public mockery. The way she bends over in front of you just to watch you squirm, then laughs and says you couldn't handle her anyway.
But this semester is different. You've had the entire winter break to think about this—about her—and you're done being her punching bag. You're finally ready to stand up to Nina Powers.
